evidence_basis.rule: No optimization may be enabled as authoritative until serial and optimized selections produce the same outcomes and retained coverage evidence.

pull_request.selection: deterministic focused checks plus the authoritative Python shard set and affected language/package gates
pull_request.cancellation: Cancel only a superseded run for the same pull-request head lineage.
pull_request.failure_visibility: Every failed shard and serial group remains a separately named required check with uploaded reports.

main.selection: full stable matrix with authoritative coverage, package, binding, documentation, security, and evidence gates
main.cancellation: Do not cancel a started main validation run.

release.selection: non-sharded full suite plus clean wheel, sdist, native binding, documentation, SBOM, provenance, and exact-artifact checks
release.cancellation: Never cancel a tag, release, publication, or manually dispatched release-candidate validation run.

preview.selection: isolated dependency, runtime, free-threaded, nextest, sccache, and serialization candidates
preview.cancellation: May cancel superseded observation runs; never emit release artifacts or satisfy stable required checks.

python_execution.authoritative_pr_mode: focused supported-version compatibility lanes plus one full bounded-xdist coverage lane

worker_policy.selection_rule: Benchmark cold and warm wall time and peak RSS on hosted runners; choose the fastest count within the memory budget and cap automatic selection at the measured winner.
worker_policy.prohibited: Unbounded -n auto is not authoritative because runner CPU count does not express memory capacity.

deterministic_sharding.algorithm: Assign each collected pytest node ID to the unsigned first 64 bits of its SHA-256 digest modulo the declared shard count; retain xdist work-stealing only within each fixed cross-runner partition.
deterministic_sharding.drift_rule: A collected node absent from every shard, duplicated across shards, or changed after collection fails the fan-in gate.

initial_membership: tests that mutate process-global lazy-module state until repaired
tests that start nested full repository harnesses
tests requiring an exclusive local service or fixed output path
serial_groups.promotion_rule: Remove a test from the serial group only after repeated-order and xdist equivalence evidence.

coverage.authoritative_lane: one supported-Python full bounded-xdist coverage run on pull requests and main; deterministic cross-runner shards remain preview-only until hosted timing evidence supports promotion
coverage.merge: The stable single-run lane needs no cross-runner merge; any preview shard fan-in must reject missing inputs before it can be considered for promotion.
coverage.compatibility_lanes: Run focused no-coverage suites on the remaining supported Python versions.
coverage.operational_assurance: Consume the authoritative coverage receipt when the exact source head and selection digest match; otherwise collect its own authoritative full coverage.
coverage.release: Run a fresh non-sharded full coverage gate; never rely solely on change selection.

change_selection.fail_closed: An unclassified changed path selects all stable lanes. Main, release, scheduled assurance, and explicit full-validation dispatches ignore change-based omission.

artifact_dag.reuse_rule: Consumers verify the source-head, interpreter ABI, platform tag, and digest before install.
Only same-platform and same-toolchain consumers may reuse it; installed-package tests invoke exported symbols.
Generate once per exact source head and verify the manifest before each consumer.
Reject absent, duplicate, stale-head, or selection-mismatched shard inputs.

cache_policy.restore_rule: Restore exact keys first; partial restore is permitted only for immutable download caches and must still execute install/build verification.
poisoning_controls: do not save caches from untrusted forks
never treat a cache hit as validation

rust.stable: cargo test workspace and required coverage remain authoritative
rust.promotion: Require identical test inventory/outcomes, archive provenance, coverage preservation, cold/warm timings, and stable cargo fallback.

r.stable: Build one exact versioned source package and pass its path explicitly to pkgcheck and R CMD check jobs.
r.cache: Cache dependency libraries only; never glob or cache source archives or check results.

julia.stable: Fast numerical smoke may precede full package tests; full Aqua and clean installed-artifact validation remain required before release.
julia.cache: Cache a lock-keyed depot and precompile environment; do not cache test outcomes.

docs.stable: Reuse one generated input artifact and one lock-keyed pnpm store while retaining Astro check, build, and link validation.
docs.avoidance: Do not recreate a tox environment merely to repeat an already verified exact-head dependency install.

profiling_and_measurement.python: Use Scalene for bounded representative workloads with CPU-only mode where memory instrumentation is unstable; complement with pytest durations, importtime, wall time, and peak RSS.
profiling_and_measurement.native: Use cargo timings/nextest reports, R check timings, Julia test timing and precompile reports, and Astro/pnpm step timings.
acceptance: exact commands and source head recorded
profiling_and_measurement.regression_policy: A statistically or operationally material regression blocks promotion or restores the previous stable execution path.

required_fan_in: all expected deterministic shards present and green
all declared serial groups present and green
authoritative coverage inputs complete and policy passed
affected installed-package and language-native gates green
security, licence, lock, and evidence checks green
no preview job is counted as a stable required check
implementation_order: repair serial/parallel outcome divergence and eager imports
optimize tracked-file harness traversal and safe subprocess duplication
benchmark bounded xdist worker counts and freeze a duration receipt
implement deterministic Python shard generation and fail-closed fan-in
consolidate authoritative coverage and focused compatibility lanes
extract exact-head wheel, native, documentation, and coverage artifacts
apply lock- and toolchain-keyed caches with poisoning controls
qualify nextest, sccache, Julia depot, and preview-runtime lanes
re-run cold/warm local and hosted timing matrix
retain a non-sharded release validation path
